title: Your goals aren't the problem. Your starting line is too big. 🎯
hook: Your goals aren't the problem. Your starting line is too big. 🎯
caption:
Your goals aren't the problem. Your starting line is too big. 🎯

Here's the hard truth behind James Clear's Atomic Habits: you don't rise to the level of your goals — you fall to the level of your systems.

The fix is the 2-Minute Rule. Shrink any habit until it takes less than two minutes to start:
• "Read before bed" → "Read one page"
• "Do 30 min of yoga" → "Take out my mat"

Because small choices don't add up — they multiply. 1% better every day = 37× better in a year. 1% worse = almost nothing.

Master showing up first. The results take care of themselves.

title: Tonight, by the time I got home, it was almost 8:00 pm.
hook: Tonight, by the time I got home, it was almost 8:00 pm.
caption:
Tonight, by the time I got home, it was almost 8:00 pm. 

I got my workout clothes out… and then instantly changed my mind.
“It’s too late.”
Funny, because I’ve worked out later than that plenty of times. 😂

And then I had to check myself.

Am I actually too tired to work out?
Does my body need recovery tonight?
Or is my brain just giving me a really convenient excuse?
Because there IS a difference.

Tonight, I had the energy. My body felt good. I was perfectly capable of doing the workout. 

So I went back, put on my workout clothes, and got it done. 
And guess what?

It was a great workout.
